definitions.old_envelope: Legacy reachable_envelope: P6 set to old P_max and every technical child to old soft_cap.
definitions.new_envelope: V1.1.7 prepared latent caps with estimated future body maxima; not actual training output.
definitions.gap: Potential target minus envelope: positive means the labelled target exceeds the structural envelope.
definitions.current_numeric_traits: All 43 learned technical values, P6, G9 and CA, excluding deliberately revised PA appraisal.
definitions.public_PA: Initial narrow appraisal, which can differ from source retrospective PA and the latent model target.

limitations: This is a structural consistency audit, not growth, championship, real-world potential or population validation.
Legacy cap envelopes can understate an already observed grandfathered skill; all statistics are therefore also reported excluding those snapshots.
The 370 entries are annual snapshots, not 370 independent contemporaneous athletes.
A compatible estimated envelope is necessary but does not guarantee the career reaches it.
